description_en: Queries a list of advanced download tasks for RDS for MySQL, RDS for PostgreSQL, and PolarDB for MySQL instances
description_zh: 查询RDS MySQL、RDS PostgreSQL、PolarDB MySQL版实例的高级下载任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun dbs describe-download-task --region-code cn-hangzhou --instance-name rm-bp1imnmcjxdz70000 --datasource-id ds-rm-2ze8g2am976240000_cn-hangzhou --backup-set-id 2160000 --state queueing --task-type full --start-time 1661941554000 --end-time 1661941556000 --page-size 50 --current-page 1 --order-direct desc --order-column gmt_create --cluster-name dds-example --api-version 2021-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDownloadTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides. To obtain the region ID, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26231.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26231.html查询
parameters.name: region_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

该参数为必填项
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source in DBS. The format is: ds-${Instance ID}_${Region ID}
parameters.help_zh: 数据源DBS标记ID，传入格式为：ds-${实例ID}_${regionId}
parameters.name: datasource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup set. To obtain the backup set ID, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26273.html
parameters.help_zh: 创建下载任务时生成的备份集ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26273.html接口查询
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The state of the download task. Valid values:

initializing: The task is being initialized.

queueing: The task is in a queue.

running: The task is running.

failed: The task failed.

finished: The task is successful.

expired: The download has expired
parameters.help_zh:
下载任务的状态，取值如下：

initializing：初始化。
queueing：排队中。
running：下载中。
failed：下载失败。
finished：下载成功。
expired：下载过期
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The type of the download task. Valid values:

full: full backup set download.

pitr: point-in-time recovery download
parameters.help_zh:
下载任务类型，取值如下：

full：全量备份集下载。
pitr：任意时间点下载
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range to query tasks based on their creation time. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds (ms)
parameters.help_zh: 按创建时间区间的起始点查询，Long类型时间戳形式，单位为毫秒（ms）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query tasks based on their creation time. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds (ms)
parameters.help_zh: 按创建时间区间的终止点查询，Long类型时间戳形式，单位为毫秒（ms）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting direction. Valid values:

asc: ascending order.

desc: descending order. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向，取值如下：

asc：正序。
desc：倒序，为默认值
parameters.name: order_direct

parameters.help_en: The field used for sorting. The default value is gmt_create, which indicates the creation time
parameters.help_zh: 默认按创建时间排序，取值：gmt_create
parameters.name: order_column

parameters.help_en: The name of the sharded cluster. This parameter is required only for MongoDB instances
parameters.help_zh: 仅MongoDB依赖，分片集群的集群名
parameters.name: cluster_name
